newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber completes private placement.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Tuesday it completed a private placement of senior discount notes with gross proceeds of about $225 million through lead managers Goldman Sachs and Salomon Brothers.

It said the notes will build up interest at 11-7/8 percent compounded semiannually for five years. After that, until maturity, cash interest will be paid semiannually at a rate of 11-7/8 percent. The notes will mature November 1, 2006.

Brooks Fiber, a local telecommunications services company, will use the money to expand its network development plans for its existing 30 markets. It has 30 networks in 16 states in operation or under construction and plans to have 50 networks operating by 1998.
